scope: Prepublication bilingual summary, numerical-claim, limitation, source-quote and staged date review for 29 proposed inclusions.

items.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
items.summary_zh: 用试跑轨迹和学生评测反复修订教师技能，跨轮保留实验史；学生每轮均从同一初始权重微调。
items.summary_en: Pilot rollout traces and student evaluations guide repeated revisions of teacher skills, with experiment history retained across rounds. Each student is fine-tuned anew from the same initial weights.
items.limitations_review: Teacher skill instructions and experiment history persist; every student SFT restarts at the same initial weights. Summary does not claim cumulative student-weight coevolution.

items.title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
items.summary_zh: 团队代理根据运行故障修复提示、工具与评测脚手架，经人工批准在热重启启用，保留各任务搜索档案。
items.summary_en: Team agents repair the prompts, tools, and evaluation harness in response to operational faults. Human-approved fixes take effect at warm restarts while each task’s search archive is preserved.
items.limitations_review: The inclusion rests on agent-driven harness repairs approved by humans at warm restarts; preserved kernel archives alone are external task products.

items.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
items.summary_zh: 对提示、技能、记忆与脚手架演化做专项评测，分析提案、选择与运行方差如何影响可辨识收益。
items.summary_en: A focused evaluation of prompt, skill, memory, and harness evolution analyzes how proposal quality, selection, and run-to-run variance affect the detectability of improvements.
items.limitations_review: Dedicated evaluation of proposal, selection and variance in agent-evolution systems; no new measured gain is asserted by the summary.

items.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
items.summary_zh: 冻结模型根据练习得分与轨迹改写提示和技能文件，并在全新会话的未见游戏上评测保留文本。
items.summary_en: Frozen models revise prompts and skill files using practice scores and transcripts, then evaluate the retained text on unseen games in fresh sessions.
items.limitations_review: Frozen weights; retained prompt and skill text is evaluated on unseen games in fresh sessions.

items.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 从机器人执行证据提炼并修订操作指引，让更新后的脚手架指导后续尝试。
items.summary_en: Embodied-Harness revises reusable operational guidance from robot execution evidence and applies the updated harness to subsequent attempts.
items.limitations_review: Reusable robotic operational guidance is revised from execution evidence; no quantitative success claim in the summary.

items.title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
items.summary_zh: 根据场景图生成的失败根因改写推理脚手架，经独立选择后保留有效版本。
items.summary_en: RoHa-SGG uses failure-root-cause analysis to revise inference harness code and selects a retained version before test evaluation.
items.limitations_review: Reusable inference-harness code is revised by failure diagnosis, with selection before final test evaluation.

items.title: NavRSI: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Vision-and-Language Navigation
items.summary_zh: 利用导航轨迹和失败诊断迭代改写代码脚手架，冻结选定版本后评估迁移。
items.summary_en: NavRSI iteratively rewrites navigation harness code from traces and diagnoses, then freezes the selected harness for transfer evaluation.
items.limitations_review: The selected navigation harness is frozen for transfer; the source distinguishes 1302 development-selection episodes from 537 held-out episodes.

items.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
items.summary_zh: 评测代理能否联合改进模型与脚手架，并在冻结的独立测试中检验最终组合。
items.summary_en: CoEvoBench evaluates joint model and harness improvement and tests the nominated frozen model–harness pair in an independent environment.
items.limitations_review: Benchmark studies joint model and harness change and separately tests the nominated frozen pair.

items.title: MedicalRSI: Medical Recursive Self-Improving Agents via Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution
items.summary_zh: 从临床任务反馈修订可执行工具和工作流技能，并与求解器、改进器训练协同迭代。
items.summary_en: MedicalRSI evolves executable tools and workflow skills from clinical task feedback alongside training of the solver and improver.
items.limitations_review: Both executable tools/workflow skills and solver/improver training are changed; weight training does not remove harness-coevolution relevance.

items.title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 从反复失败中修订提示、技能与观察控制规则，经修复和回归检查后提交更新。
items.summary_en: Sage-Evolve-Preview revises prompts, skills and observation-controller rules from recurring failures, committing updates after repair and regression checks.
items.limitations_review: Prompts, skills and observation-controller rules are revised and committed after repair/regression checks.

items.title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization
items.summary_zh: 将硬件优化失败追溯到代理脚手架决策，搜索可复用代码改动并冻结评估。
items.summary_en: Meta-RTL traces RTL-optimization failures to agent harness decisions, searches reusable code changes and evaluates a frozen selected harness.
items.limitations_review: Harness decisions and reusable code edits are distinguished from the resulting RTL artifact.

items.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
items.summary_zh: 从失败轨迹演化提示、工具描述与技能适配器，以任务效果和成本筛选可复用版本。
items.summary_en: The method evolves loadable prompt, tool-description and skill adapters from failed trajectories, retaining a Pareto archive over success, cost and latency.
items.limitations_review: External prompt, tool-description and skill adapters are evolved, with retained success/cost/latency trade-offs.

items.title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
items.summary_zh: 把运行证据转成通用需求，通过设计和代码审查将可复用脚手架更新合入后续版本。
items.summary_en: AHE-Beta turns execution evidence into general requirements and merges reusable harness updates after design and code review.
items.limitations_review: Execution evidence feeds general requirements and reviewed reusable harness updates; the summary does not imply unattended autonomous approval.

items.title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
items.summary_zh: 从失败中筛选可迁移的提示程序与视觉处理条目，再将验证后的增益逐轮内化到权重。
items.summary_en: BaseRSI selects transferable prompt procedures and visual-processing entries from failures, then iteratively internalizes their verified gains into model weights.
items.limitations_review: External prompt procedures and visual-processing entries are selected and then internalized into weights; coevolution route is supported.

items.title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
items.summary_zh: 联合修订决策模型、状态提示与行为树后测试新对手；未隔离固定权重下的控制器效果。
items.summary_en: Decision-model, state-prompt and behavior-tree updates are tested on new opponents; a fixed-weight controller effect is not isolated.
items.limitations_review: Final summary explicitly says the fixed-weight controller effect is not isolated; joint revisions are tested on additional opponents.

items.title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
items.summary_zh: 结合执行覆盖与验证反馈修订技能，并把诊断和修改策略沉淀给后续任务的改进器。
items.summary_en: SkillPlumber revises skills using execution coverage and verifier feedback, while a maintainer updates diagnostic and revision strategies for later tasks.
items.limitations_review: Task-local skill repair is separated from persistent diagnostic/revision strategies maintained for later tasks.

items.title: OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent-Group Evolution
items.summary_zh: 在开放世界中从执行经验修订可执行技能，并通过共享注册库供后续代理调用。
items.summary_en: OpenKAGE revises executable skills from open-world experience and shares them through a registry for subsequent agent use.
items.limitations_review: Executable skills and shared-registry reuse are the relevant evolving objects, rather than only world-state memory.

items.title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
items.summary_zh: 在模拟个人助理环境中从失败轨迹修订指令，经验证与独立采纳决策后用于未来任务。
items.summary_en: In a simulated personal-assistant setting, failure traces guide instruction repairs for future tasks, with validation separated from adoption.
items.limitations_review: Summary explicitly says simulated personal-assistant setting. Real model calls do not imply real account access, message delivery or transactions.

items.title: EvoTER: Evolving Embodied Agents via Tool-Use Experience and Reflection
items.summary_zh: 从工具执行经验提出技能修订，经任务验收后跨轮保留，并冻结技能评估留出任务。
items.summary_en: EvoTER proposes skill revisions from tool-use experience, retains accepted updates across rounds and freezes the skills for disjoint test tasks.
items.limitations_review: Accepted skill updates persist across rounds; disjoint test tasks use frozen skills.

items.title: Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation
items.summary_zh: 在单个episode内依据导航反馈修订策略代码与改进规则，供后续目标复用；独立episode重置。
items.summary_en: Within each episode, navigation feedback revises policy code and improvement rules for later goals; independent episodes reset both.
items.limitations_review: Final summary explicitly limits retention to later goals inside one episode and states reset between independent episodes.

items.title: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses
items.summary_zh: 统一描述可编辑脚手架与诊断、修改、验证、部署闭环，并检验模块化受控演化。
items.summary_en: The paper unifies editable harness components and the diagnose–patch–validate–deploy loop, with a study of gated modular evolution.
items.limitations_review: Historical entry presents the diagnose-patch-validate-deploy framework and gated modular evolution; not new science dated 2026-11-23.

items.title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
items.summary_zh: 用执行清单区分新回归与旧缺口，筛选并限域修订脚手架，冻结后运行未见任务。
items.summary_en: GUARD separates new regressions from unresolved gaps with execution checklists, selects scoped harness edits and freezes the result for unseen tasks.
items.limitations_review: Historical entry; source guarantees are limited to checked gate-buffer/self-review conditions, not universal improvement or safety.

items.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
items.summary_zh: 专项评测无反馈的反复技能改写，揭示专家知识流失，并测试保留原文的注意标记。
items.summary_en: This dedicated study measures repeated feedback-free skill rewriting, traces loss of expert knowledge and tests attention markers that preserve the original text.
items.limitations_review: Dedicated study of repeated feedback-free skill rewriting; summary does not falsely add external execution feedback.

items.title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
items.summary_zh: 根据重建检查修订参数化场景生成程序，将接受的程序存入库供后续场景检索适配。
items.summary_en: SceneAnything validates revisions to parameterized scene generators and stores accepted programs for retrieval and adaptation in subsequent scenes.
items.limitations_review: Inclusion rests on reusable executable scene-generator programs, not final scene meshes or task-local reconstruction artifacts alone.

items.title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
items.summary_zh: 提出版本化技能证据迁移与重新准入的理论和报告协议；尚无实现或实证结果。
items.summary_en: SCAFFOLD proposes a theory and reporting protocol for evidence transport and readmission of versioned skills, without an implementation or empirical results.
items.limitations_review: Theory and reporting protocol only; no implemented verifier, empirical superiority or universal safety proof. All three PDF excerpts independently matched with PyMuPDF.

items.title: Great Listeners, Poor Decision-Makers: Rethinking Agentic Audio AI
items.summary_zh: 以多目标演化搜索调优语音代理的动作门控，在错误风险与澄清成本之间选择策略。
items.summary_en: Multi-objective evolutionary search tunes external action-gating policies for audio agents, selecting trade-offs between action risk and clarification cost.
items.limitations_review: Offline NSGA-II action-gate parameter search is supported by source Tables VII/VIII. Clarification success q=1 or q=0.8 is an assumption, not measured human interaction success.

items.title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
items.summary_zh: 提出跨模型、脚手架、技能访问和记忆条件的配对评测协议；实验结果仍待完成。
items.summary_en: SkillBuffBench specifies paired evaluation across models, harnesses, skill-access modes and memory conditions; measured results are still pending.
items.limitations_review: Historical dedicated benchmark protocol; summary explicitly states measured results are pending.

items.title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness
items.summary_zh: 从决策执行反馈异步修订程序性模块，发布到共享库并按历史效用供后续任务复用。
items.summary_en: JevRSI asynchronously revises procedural decision-support modules from execution feedback and publishes them for later reuse through utility-aware retrieval.
items.limitations_review: Procedural modules and executable code are revised from buffered traces and reused through the shared library. Official source header and staged version are v3 dated 2026-11-19.

items.title: When Agent Skills Go Stale: Runtime Behavior and Selective Maintenance in Evolving Environments
items.summary_zh: 重放环境检查修订过期技能，验收后复用；当前实验只验证一次维护事件。
items.summary_en: Environment-check replay guides repairs to stale reusable skills; the experiments evaluate one maintenance event.
items.limitations_review: Historical entry; final summary explicitly limits evidence to one maintenance event. Automatic profile refresh and successive maintenance events are future work.

excluded_boundary_crosscheck.title: ZeroVLN
excluded_boundary_crosscheck.correction: The primary reason corrects the earlier frozen-brain claim: brain and action expert are jointly RL trained. The original independent opinion is preserved as history with an explicit correction; it is not the final rationale.
excluded_boundary_crosscheck.final_reason: ZeroVLN使用固定慢快导航框架，并通过RL训练脑模型和动作策略；未证明执行反馈会修订并保留外部提示、工具或控制机制。原独立理由的“冻结VLM”措辞不准确，原文明确jointly improve与minor weight changes，故在此纠正，排除结论不变。 范围排除基于所列原文；不声称复现实验或验证论文全部结果。

extraction_note: All 86 HTML and 3 PDF quotes match after whitespace normalization. The SCAFFOLD quotes also match the cached page extraction exactly after whitespace normalization; pypdf differs in spacing around punctuation, small caps and mathematical glyphs. PyMuPDF extraction from the hash-verified PDF resolves those mismatches without changing quotations.
limitations_explicitly_preserved: Stale-skill study evaluates one maintenance event.
System-One does not isolate a fixed-weight controller effect.
Safe Personal is simulated with delivery and transactions disabled.
AutoMaster student SFT restarts from the same initial weights.
Great Listeners clarification-success assumptions are not measured interactions.

boundaries.remote_merge_status: not verified by this crosscheck; parent publishing workflow owns merge and provenance checks
boundaries.approval: Content/date preflight pass applies only to the recorded hashes; it does not certify CI, merged provenance, rendered output or online deployment.
